caption: The drawing depicts a two-story house with a porch on both the upper and lower levels, painted in light yellow tones with brown and purple shading. The house has rectangular windows and a red brick chimney on the right side of the roof. In front of the house, there are two large, leafy green trees whose branches and leaves partially obscure the house. A small garden bed with red, yellow, and purple flowers is situated at the base of the porch. The house is elevated, with a staircase in the center leading up to the porch. The property is enclosed by a green metal fence with red brick posts at the entrance gate, which is directly aligned with the steps. The foreground features a grey stone sidewalk running parallel to the fence. The artist’s signature, "G.E. Cook," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Stewart House
